additional_info.subject: ID0409695-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001327]  Connector faulted CRM:00642002091
additional_info.body:
Hello Marnic,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Sparki
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / PD 170001327
Charger ID/Serial No.:
1yeqgn
Problem Description:
Connector faulted
FYI-
We have reviewed the logs, and our initial analysis indicates abnormalities related to the switching matrix, likely due to a contactor issue.
Please check the error flag on SCB first to confirm which component has failed. please follow below the necessary troubleshooting steps to resolve it.
status: failed, reason: smc[0,1,2,3]-[states]-[results]
status: failed, reason: smc[0,1,2,3]-[P,P,P,S]-[0,0,0,0] : in charger
So SMC0 : QA9/QA10
SMC1: QA11/QA12
SMC2: QA17/QA18
SMC3: QA15/QA16
In error code status [F,S,S,S]: denotes SMC0 contactor check  failed & SMC1,2,3 is skipped
[0,0,0,0]: denotes Contactor QA9/QA10 feedback is not received
Steps to Check DC Contactor Operation (24V Supply)
Power Supply Verification
Ensure a stable 24V DC supply is available and correctly connected to the contactor coil terminals.
Use a multimeter to measure the voltage at the coil terminals before energizing.
Contactor Pick-Up Test (Engagement Check)
Apply 24V DC to the coil and observe if the contactor pulls in (engages) properly.
Listen for a clear clicking sound, indicating proper engagement.
Measure the coil current to ensure it is within the rated specifications.
Contactor Drop-Out Test (Release Check)
Remove the 24V supply and check if the contactor drops out (de-energizes) correctly.
Ensure there is no delay or sticking in the contacts.
Listen for the release click sound when the coil is de-energized.
Contact Status Verification
Check NO (Normally Open) and NC (Normally Closed) contacts using a multimeter in continuity mode:
When energized, NO contacts should close, and NC contacts should open.
When de-energized, NO contacts should open, and NC contacts should close.
During the site intervention, please carry a spare contactor in case a replacement is needed.
hope this would clear your query.
Spare part contactor-: 8EM5903-0AA00-7AA8
